sources.snippet: The Hurwitz zeta function zeta(s,a), often shortened to Hurwitz zeta, is a generalization of the Riemann zeta function zeta(s) that is also known as the generalized zeta function. It is classically defined by the formula zeta(s,a)=sum_(k=0)^infty1/((k+a)^s) (1) for Re[s]>1 and by analytic continuation to other s!=1, where any term with k+a=0 is excluded. sources.title: Measurement of the CKM angle $γ$ in $B^{\pm} \rightarrow D(\rightarrow K^{0}_{\rm S} h^{\prime+}h^{\prime-})h^{\pm}$ decays with a novel approach
